data.body:
CLOSED — merged and verified. Gerrit 1963 landed on `origin/main` as 897ae2e1c4 (rebased sha;
authored locally as a13190d82c under Rebase-If-Necessary). Both gates confirmed by direct REST
query rather than taken on report: `LLM-Review +1` (rebar review bot), `Verified +1` (rebar CI
bot), change status MERGED, and the commit is reachable from a worktree fast-forwarded to
origin/main. Closed `--class=regression --caused-by=8d36-a15a-fcbd-4ebd`.

## Acceptance criteria — all three met by landed code

- AC1 (pin the mode OR correct the docstring): took the docstring arm and went further. The
  comment now states the mark is honoured ONLY under `--dist loadgroup`. The addopts arm was
  deliberately NOT taken: addopts are prepended, so CI's explicit `--dist worksteal` would
  still win — it would have been protection in appearance only.
- AC2 (group the second live test): done; end-to-end proof is the group going 16 -> 17 members.
- AC3 (a guard for future live tests): `test_every_live_jira_test_is_xdist_group_confined`,
  mutation-verified.

Ticking the boxes changed ONLY checkbox characters — verified by diffing the before/after
descriptions with both box states normalised to the same token, which came back identical. This
ticket carried no plan-review attestation (`signature: null`) in any case.

## Reproduced bug 10d0-c26c-bdbb-4b1f (ruling-magnific-bats) on this close

Passing `--caused-by` when an identical `caused_by` edge already existed created a SECOND
duplicate edge to the same target — link_uuids 8b828d0a (from the earlier `rebar link`) and
93b33884 (from the close). This is a third confirmed occurrence of that defect. Removed the
duplicate with `rebar unlink … caused_by`, which removed exactly one edge as documented; **one
`caused_by` edge to 8d36-a15a-fcbd-4ebd now remains**, verified after the fact.

Worth noting for that bug's own RCA: passing the flag is still right despite the duplicate. An
empty `--caused-by` re-runs blame auto-derivation unconditionally, and here blame would have
named a June file-move carrier in `test_cli.py` — a wrong edge, which is a worse input to the
escape-rate metric than a duplicate correct one.
